about_the_game:
Thank you for your interest in Fates Masquerade! Please note that this free demo showcases the beginning of the story. The art, animations, and direction are works in progress that are continuously being polished for the final game.

As a young child, you witnessed the downfall of your noble house, a tragedy shrouded in mystery. Who were your family members? Who killed them and why?

Years later, your search for answers leads you to the heart of the empire, where you become a governess to a young princess.

You try to steer clear of the court's dangerous intrigues until the princess falls seriously ill. This forces you to seek help from one of the two imperial princes.

Crown Prince Maximilian Windrake

Known across the Empire as the Crimson Reaper, he is a brilliant strategist and stoic warrior who is feared and revered equally by friends and foes. He prioritizes duty above all else, but behind his cold exterior is a man whom few truly know.

But the more you get to know him, the harder it becomes to resist his quiet strength and vulnerability hidden beneath his armor. Can you win his guarded heart and help him find happiness?

Prince Lucian Windrake

As the Empire’s infamous charmer, he is magnetic, cunning, and always one step ahead. His easy smile hides a world of secrets and dangerous dealings. He’s seductive, unpredictable, and utterly impossible to ignore. But behind his playful grin lies a web of secrets, shadows, and carefully crafted deception.

Will you uncover the truths he keeps hidden? Or will you lose yourself in the illusion he so expertly weaves?

You will be swept into a perilous game of power, betrayal, and war, where enemies lurk in plain sight and every decision has the power to tip the balance of the empire.

Will you uncover the truth about your past?

Will you survive the web of lies surrounding the throne?

When your heart is on the line, will love be your salvation or your downfall?

All characters are fully animated, bringing the story to life through detailed movements and rich expressions.

The major characters receive extra attention, making every glance, smile, and reaction feel truly alive.

Here are some of the in-game footage videos:

Lucian’s signature wink

Victoria’s iconic eye roll

Maximilian showing rare vulnerability

Customizable Heroine

Name your heroine and shape her personality. Will she be bold or reserved? Cunning or kind? Your choices will influence the way the story unfolds and how the romantic interests perceive you.

Two Unique Routes

The brothers are like night and day, offering two very different love stories. One may be tender while the other is intense, but both can be sweet, heart-wrenching, and utterly unforgettable.

8+ Endings

Your choices matter. Many paths lead to unique conclusions, ranging from betrayals and tragic twists to happily ever afters. There are also many ways to meet an untimely end.

Spicy Scenes?

Yes, there will be spice, and things will get very spicy once you bring powerful princes to their knees. 

Animated CGs

Many pivotal moments in the story are brought to life through beautifully illustrated and animated CGs, adding emotional depth and cinematic flair to your journey.

content_descriptors.notes: Fate's Masquerade contains mature themes, and player discretion is advised. These include but are not limited to violence, blood, murder, human death, animal death, strong language, alcohol references, and sexual references.

  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible (Apple silicon supported through Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0

short_description: Looking for steamy romances with brooding and enigmatic princes? Step into Fate’s Masquerade, where danger meets desire. Unravel secrets, navigate court politics, and make choices that shape your destiny. Along the way, surrender to love so powerful it will change the fate of an empire.
